title: Farberware Easy Solutions Nonstick Bakeware, Includes 10 Inch x 15 Inch Cookie Baking Sheet and 12-Cup Muffin Pan, 2 Piece - Blue
features: DOUBLE THE NONSTICK: Farberware Easy Solutions baking pans feature an enhanced, two-layer nonstick for excellent release and long lasting nonstick durability.
HEAVY-DUTY BAKEWARE: Farberware Easy Solutions bake pans are made with durable, heavy-duty steel construction to resist warping and facilitate faster, more even baking.
A STEADY HOLD: Our extra-wide handles provide a comfortable, confident grip (even with oven mitts on!).
SLICE IT UP: Our Easy Slice Guide markings on the pan's rim make it a cinch to cut perfectly even portion sizes every time.
FILL IT UP: Our Easy Fill Guide markings on the inside of the muffin cups make it a cinch to pour perfectly even portions every time.
